newsitem.title: FRANCE: DHL flies urgent cross-channel cargo on Tue.
newsitem.headline: DHL flies urgent cross-channel cargo on Tue.

text.p: DHL Worldwide Express said it planned to operate a contingency flight this evening to handle road-borne freight which would have normally been transported via the Channel Tunnel, DHL s network planning manager, Europe-Middle East/Africa, Malcolm Macbeth, told Reuters.

"Our contingency plans do entail using the ferries for non-premium shipments but our "Tunnel" freight destined to be transported by air this evening is in the "next-day before midday" and "before 10.30am" deadline category," Macbeth said.

"While there is a chance Eurotunnel's .freight shuttles will be back in service in some shape or form later this evening , we have decided on a cautious approach and will put on an extra Boeing 727 freighter flight between London or Luton and Brussels from where shipments will be trucked to our main European centres and vice versa," he said.
On most evenings, DHL operates six nightly routes in each direction via the Tunnel linking its London distribution centre with Paris/CDG, Brussels and Breda in Holland.
